text.description_html:
AHI SIG722S-630 Contemporary Stainless Flush Ring Pull

This is a heavy duty contemporary design flush mount ring pull. The 2-3/4 inch square stainless steel flush ring pulls is resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. The Satin Stainless Steel Contemporary Flush Mount Door Pull is for use on swinging doors, sliding doors, trap doors, cabinet doors. Any door where a flush with the door face pull is desired.

Also available Larger 3-7/16" x 3-7/16" Satin Stainless Contemporary Flush Ring Pull

Specifications for the AHI SIG722S-630 Stainless Flush Ring Pull:

  • Total Height: 2-3/4" (70 MM)
  • Total Width: 2-3/4" (70 MM)
  • Total Depth: 9/16" (14 MM)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 7/16"
  • Projection: 1/8" (If square face is not mortised)
  • Door Cutout Diameter: 2-5/16"
  • 1/8" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with matching satin stainless mounting screws
  • AHI SIG722S Dimensions (PDF)

**Note: If the square flush pull face is NOT mortised into the door, it will have a 1/8" projection off the doors face. Available in Satin Stainless Steel finish only.




***Item Discontinued Use Flush Mount Door Pull Satin Stainless Steel
